question_types: relative valuation or performance of two or more companies

evidence_requirements.description: Resolve every company to an entity id; confirm listing, currency and fiscal year-end.
Same standard lines for each company over aligned periods (trailing twelve months or matched fiscal frames).
evidence_requirements.freshness: latest filed period of each company as of research_clock
evidence_requirements.acceptance: same line items, period and unit across companies
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use filing text and mark the lines non-standardized.

evidence_requirements.description: Margins, growth and returns computed by one formula for all companies.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: one calculation per company and metric
evidence_requirements.fallback: Show formulas in the report and mark them unaudited.

evidence_requirements.description: Price or return series over the same window, if market comparison is asked.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Omit; label any quoted prices as not market data.

evidence_requirements.description: Business-mix or strategy differences from filings or reports.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that qualitative differences were not researched.

look_for: differences in accounting policy that distort the comparison
a company or period where the ranking reverses
segment mix that makes the pair not comparable
counter_evidence.if_none_found: State what was searched and that no reversal was found.

unit_and_period_checks: fiscal calendars differ: align by period end date, state offsets
currency conversion rate, date and source stated
GAAP vs IFRS or adjusted vs reported labelled

reconciliation.note: spot-check at least one line per company

stopping_conditions: all companies have the same lines for aligned periods
a company lacks data: compare the rest and list the gap

must_state: as-of date and period of every column

limits: frames and standardized lines may not exist for non-US filers
ratios are not valuation or recommendations
